result.title: Edge-Assisted Crowdsensing for Explainable Cyclist Safety Perception
result.summary: Cyclist fatality rates remain high despite policy support for active travel, and autonomous vehicles add complexity to mixed traffic. Neither crash statistics nor multi-model detection pipelines scale to continuous monitoring of perceived safety along a route. We present an edge-assisted crowdsensing system: handlebar cameras supply street-level frames, a vision-language model (VLM) turns each frame into structured traffic attributes through a single prompt, and an explainable boosting machine (EBM) combines them with OpenStreetMap road infrastructure and on-bike kinematics to predict a crowdsourced 1-9 safety score. Extraction belongs at the network edge: the fastest self-hosted model needs 2.49 s per frame and scoring takes 0.4 ms on a CPU. On 1,362 annotated frames from two London routes, the EBM regressor reaches 72.2 percent binary accuracy and a mean absolute error of 1.011 under five-fold cross-validation. It is within one accuracy point of black-box ensembles. Its per-feature shape functions give exact attribution: physical lane separation is worth +0.97 rating points, a painted lane +0.70 and a construction site -0.65. Planners can therefore price an infrastructure change in rating points, and the results enter cost-benefit analysis directly. We also report inter-annotator agreement (alpha = 0.4695), an attribute audit, and a sensitivity analysis linking attribute error to accuracy. With re-encoding, a 20 s sampling interval serves 1,000 riders at 54 Mbit/s at a cost of 1.4 accuracy points, making continuous monitoring practical.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建边缘辅助众感知系统：车把摄像头提供街景帧，VLM 以单次提示把每帧转成结构化交通属性，再由可解释提升机结合 OSM 道路设施与骑行运动学数据，预测 1-9 的众包安全评分，并给出精确的特征贡献归因。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「VLM 抽取属性→属性审计→属性误差对下游精度的敏感度分析」可供核查视觉证据是否真正进入决策、显式信息瓶颈是否充分的评价思路，但与 latent 状态生成和推理机制无直接联系，属较远领域的概念启发。
